headline: Last session: Sensex slipped into red while Nifty gained 75 points as markets tested the 23,000 support zone.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 21 September.

why: Sensex slipped into the red following CAS while Nifty managed a 75-point gain.
The market faced volatility as investors tested the Nifty 23,000 support zone.
Mixed global cues and domestic profit booking influenced the last session's performance.
Traders remained cautious ahead of the weekend regarding FII and crude oil data.
whatHappening: Axis Bank is reportedly collaborating with Apple Pay for a potential rollout in India.
Paytm shares are under observation following recent market opening trends and crashes.
Ansell is expanding its global manufacturing footprint with a new plant in Perundurai.
Market participants are analyzing if the Nifty can successfully defend the 23,000 level.
summary: The Indian stock market ended its last session with mixed results as the Nifty 50 gained 75 points while the Sensex declined. Investors are currently observing a weekend closure with the market set to reopen for regular trading on Monday, September 21. Key focus remains on the 23,000 support level for Nifty and corporate developments like the potential Apple Pay and Axis Bank partnership.
